name: reviewer
title: 品質審査の5基準（実行・根拠・決定形・代表に上げる量・制約）
context: The document is written in Japanese. It was produced by one department of a company whose CEO runs eight businesses (an online school EXTAGE, a training business POTEX, a clinic T-Clinic, an exosome product, an exam-prep service passlabo, an unemployment-insurance support service, and a subsidy consulting service). A separate quality reviewer scores it. The CEO has final authority on everything, so deliverables must decide, not propose, and must not pile decisions onto him.

executable.label: 1. 実行できるか
executable.instructions: Can the reader act on this document today or tomorrow?
criteria: Ends with 'consider' or 'organize', or is only a measurement design with no deliverable to act on
Actions exist but who, what, or by-when is missing for some of them
Who, what, and by when are all specified for every action
executable.fix: 誰が・何を・いつまでに、を全部の打ち手に付ける。設計だけで実行物が無いのは不可

grounded.label: 2. 根拠があるか
grounded.instructions: Are the figures and claims in the document supported by sources?
criteria: Contains figures, achievements, testimonials, or prices with no source at all, or that appear invented
Some figures have sources, others are asserted without one
Every figure has a source (meeting name and date, or sheet name) and unverified items are explicitly marked
grounded.fix: 数字に出典（会議名・日付・シート名）を付ける。未確認は未確認と書く

fabrication.label: 実在しない実績・声・価格
fabrication.instructions: Does the document contain achievements, customer testimonials, or prices that appear to be invented rather than taken from a record?
fabrication.fix: 即不可。削って作り直す

decisive.label: 3. 決定形か
decisive.instructions: Does the document decide, rather than propose?
criteria: Lists options A/B/C side by side, or ends with 'we propose' / 'please decide'
One recommendation is made, but there is no statement of when it is decided (today / this week / not now)
One recommendation, with reasoning, and an explicit decision timing (today / this week / not now)
decisive.fix: 推奨を1つに絞り、「今日決める／今週決める／今は決めない」を書く

ceo_decisions_count.label: 4. 代表に上げる件数
ceo_decisions_count.instructions: How many separate items does the document ask the CEO to personally decide?

criteria.zero: Nothing is left for the CEO to decide

ceo_decisions_count.fix: 代表が決めるものは3件未満に。金額・契約・株式・人事・事業の存続以外は任せ先を名指しして下ろす

delegation_named.label: 4. 任せ先が実名
delegation_named.instructions: For the items that are delegated rather than decided by the CEO, is a specific named person given as the assignee, rather than 'the person in charge' or a team name?
delegation_named.fix: 「担当者に」ではなく実名で書く

unemployment_insurance_proxy.label: 5. 失業保険：申請代行に触れる
unemployment_insurance_proxy.instructions: Does the document describe or imply preparing or filing unemployment-insurance application documents on behalf of a client?
unemployment_insurance_proxy.fix: 申請書類の代行に読める表現を消す。情報提供と本人申請のサポートの線に戻す

exosome_claims.label: 5. エクソソーム：吸収の断定・ミネラル結合型の強調
exosome_claims.instructions: Does the document assert that the exosome product is absorbed by the body, or emphasize a 'mineral-bound' form as a selling point?
exosome_claims.fix: 「吸収される」の断定と、ミネラル結合型の強調を削る

clinic_ad_rules.label: 5. Tクリニック：医療広告規制・口コミ見返り
clinic_ad_rules.instructions: Does the document contain medical advertising that would breach advertising rules (efficacy guarantees, before/after claims without required disclosures), or offer an incentive in exchange for reviews?
clinic_ad_rules.fix: 効果の保証・ビフォーアフター・口コミへの見返りを削る。医療広告ガイドラインに当てる

heading_standalone.label: 6. 見出しだけで意味が通る
heading_standalone.instructions: Look only at the headings/titles (h1, h2, section titles). Can a reader understand each slide's or section's single message from the heading alone, without the body?
criteria: Headings are abstract labels or noun phrases (e.g. 'Things to fix', 'About X', '...のこと') that cannot be understood without reading the body
Most headings are full sentences, but some are labels or contain two claims
Every heading is one complete sentence with a subject and predicate that states that unit's single message
heading_standalone.fix: 見出しを主語と述語のある1文にする。名詞句・抽象語だけの見出しは書き直す

one_message.label: 6. 1スライド1メッセージ
one_message.instructions: Does any slide or section carry more than one main message — for example a heading with two claims, two or more sub-headings of equal weight, or a body that argues something different from the heading?
one_message.fix: 1枚1主張に割る。小見出しが2本以上あるスライドは分けるか、片方を削る

natural_japanese.label: 6. 日本語が自然か
natural_japanese.instructions: Judge the Japanese prose. Is it natural for a Japanese business reader, or does it read as translated, over-compressed, or ambiguous (missing subjects, unclear demonstratives like それ/ここ, chained 〜のは〜からです)?
criteria: Many sentences read as translated or compressed; subjects are missing or demonstratives are unclear
Mostly natural, with a few awkward or ambiguous sentences
Reads as natural Japanese throughout; every sentence has a clear subject and referent
natural_japanese.fix: 不自然な文を、主語を補って普通の日本語に書き直す。文案を必ず添える

style_consistent.label: 6. 文体と用語の統一
style_consistent.instructions: Within the document, are polite (です・ます) and plain/noun-ending styles mixed inside the same unit, or is the same concept called by two different terms (e.g. an action list called both 'やること' and 'ネクストアクション')?
style_consistent.fix: 文体を1つに揃える。同じものは同じ言葉で呼ぶ
